newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-PHILIPPOUSSIS PARTS WITH ANOTHER COACH.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-PHILIPPOUSSIS PARTS WITH ANOTHER COACH.

text.p: Philippoussis has sacked coach Peter McNamara to work with
Australia Davis Cup captain John Newcombe, his management group
"Peter has had a positive influence on my development and I
will continue to build on the advice he has given me,"
Philippoussis said in a statement issued by his management
"Mark has decided that he must develop new aspects in his
game in order to reach the next level...Consequently, McNamara
will no longer act as Mark's coach," the statement added.
"A travelling coach for 1997 is yet to be appointed," it
